input.task: Choose two different local model jobs for inquiries. The baseline forest still handles exact-product recommendations. The trusted trainer fits priors and selects shrinkage8/32/128 using whole-market cross-validation.

recipes.response_hurdle: Learn P(response) from all previous contacts, and P(retained purchase | response) plus value from matured responders. This avoids treating unresolved positives as negatives.
recipes.mature_reward: Learn retained probability and payment reward from settled contacts only, using the same26-day horizon as baseline but trained cohort structure and shrinkage.

grouping.intent_status: Also distinguish new and returning shoppers. More specific but sparser.

output.rationale: The intent_status grouping captures the significant differences between new and returning shoppers, but requires the response hurdle to handle sparsity. The intent grouping with mature reward offers a stable alternative.
output.hypothesis: Using response hurdle with intent_status will leverage all contact data to estimate response rates for sparse new/returning segments, while mature reward with intent grouping provides a robust baseline for settled contacts.

input.task: Select model + campaign for two different proposed portfolios A and B. We will measure both. Keep baseline as an available fallback. Prediction scores alone are not profit.

modelUse.replace: Replace inquiry probabilities and financial ranking with the fitted model. Earlier trials showed that better prediction could damage merchant value.
modelUse.audit: Preserve v1 probability/ranking. Veto an inquiry only if the fitted model expects negative payment value even with a two-standard-deviation optimistic response estimate and there are no unresolved responders in its cohort. This is a planning heuristic, not a calibrated95% guarantee. Never permanently stop the market.

campaigns.open_discovery: Positive-value needs inquiries can reach consenting shoppers without recent browsing. Recommendations still require current interest.
campaigns.intent_assistance: Only recent interest; inquiry after ambiguous browsing, exact product after explicit search.
campaigns.reactivation: Prior buyers inactive for14days; same consent and funds guards.

objectives.joint: Rank payment plus retailer expected value.
objectives.paypal: Rank expected payment contribution, still require positive retailer expected value.

input.weeklyProbe: If every candidate is rejected, allow at most one needs inquiry every7days when v1 still expects positive payment value (audit mode), or the one-SD optimistic new estimate is positive (replace mode). Same budgets and consent. A bounded disagreement probe, not guaranteed profit.

output.rationale: Using audit mode prevents the new probability models from displacing valuable baseline choices, addressing the previous limitation. We test both models under open_discovery to safely veto negative expected value inquiries while preserving baseline rankings.
